title: Panah

hinglish.verse1:
Meri ummeed aur rihayi hai tu
Har gham mein tu hi mera meet
Rakhe mujhe apne kareeb
Ae Khuda, tu mera yakeen
hinglish.chorus:
Tufaan mein tu panah
Tu hamraahi mera
Marham toote dil ka
Yeshu, Raja mera
hinglish.verse2:
Saanson se bhi zyada azeez
Tu hi hai meri zindagi
Bin tere main, kuch bhi nahi
Yeshu tu hi, manzil meri
hinglish.chorus2:
Tufaan mein tu panah
Tu hamraahi mera

seo_description: Panah lyrics in Hindi and Hinglish by Jobin David and Sheldon Bangera - Nations of Worship.
